decision: Selected the official federal building-address record EGAID 102359099 (Tennisweg / Chemin du Tennis 6, 2504 Biel/Bienne; EGID 191642154), served in WGS84 by api3.geo.admin.ch, as the project locator. identity_bridge: NorthC page 'Datacenter Biel (Bern)' (datePublished 2022-07-18, dateModified 2026-03-31): Adresse: Tennisweg 6, 2504 Biel (Bern); total area 3,880 m2; total power 4 MW; designed to Tier III.

NorthC post of 30 September 2026: NorthC operates its Swiss data-centre network with data centres in Münchenstein, Biel and Winterthur; the four carrier- and cloud-neutral data centres in Münchenstein, Biel and Winterthur serve customers today.

The federal search returns exactly one official address for Tennisweg 6 2504 Biel (EGAID 102359099, bilingual street name Tennisweg / Chemin du Tennis), linked to GWR EGID 191642154: an existing (status 1004) non-residential building of class 1251, built 2018, 1,484 m2 footprint, 5 storeys. GWR gives parcel 11089 with EGRID CH587164367892; the cadastral survey returns two coincident parcels at the point with identical 3,296 m2 outlines, 11089 (EGRID CH467864367109) and 11102 (EGRID CH587164367892, real-estate type 0), so the register pairing of number and EGRID differs but both outlines contain the address.
